item.expectation: `handleAnnouncementFailure` removes the copy returned by `store.get`, and `store.remove` removes only the exact stored object, so the stored manifest is not removed.
item.finding: The announcement failure path reaches handleAnnouncementFailure, which removes the manifest with store.removeTemporary(). The Plan Store Contract defines removeTemporary as deleting temporary bytes, while the Manifest Store Contract requires store.remove(storedObject) to remove a stored manifest, so the stored manifest is not removed when announcement delivery fails.
